items.source: Delegation is based on explicit knowledge of the implementations of the default loaders for XML configuration files and Groovy scripts and annotated classes. Specifically, the delegation algorithm is as follows:

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied merged configuration is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的合并配置为 null

items.source: Placing an empty @ContextConfiguration annotation on a test class signals that default resource locations (for example, XML configuration files or Groovy scripts) or default configuration classes should be detected. Furthermore, if a specific ContextLoader or SmartContextLoader is not explicitly declared via @ContextConfiguration, a concrete subclass of AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader will be used as the default loader, thus providing automatic support for either path-based resource locations (for example, XML configuration files and Groovy scripts) or annotated classes, but not both simultaneously.
items.translation: 在测试类上放置一个空的 `@ContextConfiguration` 注解，表示应检测默认资源位置（例如 XML 配置文件或 Groovy 脚本）或默认的 配置类。此外，如果未通过 @ContextConfiguration 显式声明特定的 ContextLoader 或 SmartContextLoader，则将使用 AbstractDelegatingSmartContextLoader 的具体子类作为默认加载器，从而提供对基于路径的资源位置（例如 XML 配置文件和 Groovy 脚本）或带注解的类的自动支持，但不同时支持两者。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 6.0, this class implements AotContextLoader. Consequently, the candidate getXmlLoader() and getAnnotationConfigLoader() must also implement AotContextLoader in order to provide AOT support.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 6.0 起，该类实现了 AotContextLoader。因此，候选的 getXmlLoader() 和 getAnnotationConfigLoader() 也必须实现 AotContextLoader，以提供 AOT 支持。

items.source: Any reference to an XML-based loader can be interpreted to mean a context loader that supports only XML configuration files or one that supports both XML configuration files and Groovy scripts simultaneously.
items.translation: 任何对基于 XML 的加载器的引用，既可以指仅支持 XML 配置文件的支持上下文加载器，也可以指同时支持 XML 配置文件和 Groovy 脚本的上下文加载器。

items.source: A test class may optionally declare neither path-based resource locations nor annotated classes and instead declare only application context initializers. In such cases, an attempt will still be made to detect defaults, but their absence will not result in an exception.
items.translation: 测试类可以选择不声明基于路径的资源位置或已注解的类，而仅声明应用上下文初始化器。在这种情况下，仍然会尝试检测默认值，但它们的缺失不会导致异常。
自 Spring Framework 6.2.4 起，推荐使用 loadContextForAotProcessing(MergedContextConfiguration, RuntimeHints)； 将在 Spring Framework 8.0 中移除。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied configuration attributes are null, or if the supplied configuration attributes include both resource locations and annotated classes
items.translation: `IllegalArgumentException` - 如果提供的配置属性为`null`，或者提供的配置属性同时包含资源位置和注解类时。

items.source: If the resource locations or annotated classes in the supplied ContextConfigurationAttributes are not empty, the appropriate candidate loader will be allowed to process the configuration as is, without any checks for detection of defaults.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `ContextConfigurationAttributes` 中的资源位置或注解类不为空，则允许适当的候选加载器按原样处理该配置，而无需执行任何默认值检测检查。

items.source: If the resource locations in the supplied MergedContextConfiguration are not empty and the annotated classes are empty, the XML-based loader will load the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中的资源位置不为空，且注解类为空，则基于 XML 的加载器将加载 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source: If the annotated classes in the supplied MergedContextConfiguration are not empty and the resource locations are empty, the annotation-based loader will load the ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 如果提供的 `MergedContextConfiguration` 中的注释类不为空，且资源位置为空，则基于注释的加载器将加载 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the XML-based loader detects default configuration classes; if the annotation-based loader detects default resource locations; if neither candidate loader detects defaults for the supplied context configuration; or if both candidate loaders detect defaults for the supplied context configuration
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果基于 XML 的加载器检测到默认配置类；如果基于注解的加载器检测到默认资源位置；如果两个候选加载器均未检测到所提供上下文配置的默认项；或者如果两个候选加载器均检测到所提供上下文配置的默认项。

items.source: Otherwise, the XML-based loader will be allowed to process the configuration in order to detect default resource locations. If the XML-based loader detects default resource locations, an info message will be logged.
items.translation: 否则，基于 XML 的加载器将被允许处理配置以检测默认资源位置。如果基于 XML 的加载器检测到默认资源位置，将记录一条 `info` 消息。

items.source: Subsequently, the annotation-based loader will be allowed to process the configuration in order to detect default configuration classes. If the annotation-based loader detects default configuration classes, an info message will be logged.
items.translation: 随后，基于注解的加载器将被允许处理配置以检测默认配置类。如果基于注解的加载器检测到默认配置类，将记录一条 `info` 级别的消息。
